entries.title: New seasonal equipment and Technophobia
changes: Added August exotic assault rifle and Forward Observer exotic mask with their supplied PvE and PvP talent values.
Added Field General with Helping Hand, Blitz, and Water Boy, including mode-specific bonuses. Core attributes are not yet confirmed.
Added Magnet, Siphon, Thrive, and Hearty named gear with their fixed attributes.
Added Blackout and Power Spike with Perfect Technophobia. Added Technophobia / Perfect Technophobia to Weapon Talents, provisionally applicable to all weapon categories.
Acquisition sources and other unprovided attributes remain unspecified.

entries.title: Y8S4 PTS — Gear and Exotic Balance Changes
changes: Added provisional Y8S4 Public Test Server balance values.
Updated eight gear sets: Aegis, Foundry Bulwark, Measured Assembly, Heartbreaker, Hunter's Fury, Tipping Scales, Concentrated Company, and Core Strength.
Updated 27 existing exotic items, including affected talents and weapon mods. Prima Donna is missing from the reference and was not added.
Exotic mod updates apply in both PvE and PvP. Preserved existing PvP talent values where talent changes are PvE-only.
Added Increased Threat bonuses to Aegis and Foundry Bulwark in both modes; retained previous PvP values for other changed gear-set bonuses.

Base statistics are not structurally modeled: Ouroboros base Rate of Fire changes from 1275 to 1200 and base Magazine Size from 50 to 25; St. Elmo's Engine base Magazine Size changes from 40 to 30. Their updated magazine mods (+25 and +40 rounds respectively) are recorded separately on the items.
Outside the tracked datasets: Threat per Bullet is doubled for Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols, and halved for Assault Rifles, Rifles, and Marksman Rifles.

Outside the tracked datasets: Quantum Augment grants a 1.6% chance at Level 1 and a 4.3% chance at Level 10 of 70% Damage Resistance for 2 seconds instead of damage immunity. The bonus cannot refresh while active.
PTS balance values are provisional and subject to change before the official Y8S4 release.

entries.title: Provisional gear set balance update
changes: Updated PvE bonuses and talents for Aegis, Foundry Bulwark, Measured Assembly, and Heartbreaker.
Preserved previous PvP talent values and Aegis Health; added +150% Increased Threat per Bullet to Aegis and Foundry Bulwark in both modes.
These are provisional PTS values and may change before the official Y8S4 release. This update covers the four listed gear sets; other data remains unchanged.
